snippet.title: Order of the Sinking Star World Premiere Trailer from The Game Awards 2025
snippet.description:
Watch the Order of the Sinking Star World Premiere Trailer from The Game Awards 2025. Live from Peacock Theater in Los Angeles on December 11th 2025. Celebrate the best and see what's next in video games at The Game Awards 2025.
